title: cyrtococcum oxyphyllum
intro: Cyrtococcum oxyphyllum, commonly known as the Indian cup grass, is a species of grass native to India and Southeast Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The health benefits of Cyrtococcum oxyphyllum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as cancer and cardiovascular disease. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
